_capture.provenance: SYNTHETIC — no recording of this endpoint exists in the baseline and this programme has no account that could make one. manifest-authenticated.md § Session records that re-authenticating 'carries a randomised arithmetic captcha and an SMS OTP, and re-running it burns a real SMS', and a chat capture would additionally need a real thread WRITTEN to a live account, which the slot 16-47 session explicitly refused. B2-AC-36's 'real recorded staging payloads' standard is reported NOT EVALUATED with that reason and never PASS (specs.md § 2.2 Finding I, § 6.11, B9-AC-57).
_capture.credential: none — no host was contacted to build this file
_capture.envelope: PLAIN ARRAY, not paged. endpoints.ts:155 is api.get<ChatThread[]>, unlike /me/notifications and /me/chat/.../messages which are api.paged. Three envelope shapes across four GETs in one batch (specs.md § 5), and guessing the wrong one is what produced the shape-wrong me-notifications-unread-count.json (§ 2.2 Finding H).
_capture.chosen_to_discriminate: All four `status` values appear, so a port that treats `resolved` or `closed` as active picks a different activeThread (:68 admits only open|pending). The CLOSED thread carries unread_citizen: 5 — the launcher badge sums EVERY thread's count regardless of status (:127), so a port that filtered to active threads would render 2 where the source renders 7. assigned_name is null on the first active thread and set on the second, which is what selects the header title (:217) AND suppresses the bot suggestion chips (:190-191).
